title: Evaluation of Serum Taurine as a Prognostic Marker for Graft Function in Adult Egyptian Patients Undergoing Living Donor Liver Transplant

sections.abstract: Although the hepatoprotective properties of taurine are well established, however the correlation of the perioperative serum level of this amino acid in the recipients of living donor liver transplantation ( LDLT ) and graft function has not been investigated so far. In the present study, we proposed to examine the serum taurine as a prognostic marker for graft function in adult Egyptian patients undergoing LDLT
